findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "test_strategy_code" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: test_strategy_code · Private data: check_trading_record, test_strategy_code · Public sink: test_strategy_code, get_lab_status · Destructive: check_trading_record.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: test_strategy_code · Private data: check_trading_record, test_strategy_code · Public sink: test_strategy_code, get_lab_status · Destructive: check_trading_record

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
